title: FastRoverVLA: Fast Vision-Language-Action Execution for Off-Road Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.26242v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Off-road vision-language-action (VLA) models generate scene-conditioned plans, but frequent trajectory updates can repeatedly invoke expensive multimodal inference. Reusing a prediction reduces this demand while leaving its commands exposed to changes in vehicle motion. FastRoverVLA addresses this mismatch by decoupling visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution. Its training-free interface maintains decoded plans between visual predictions. A speed-curvature action buffer is aligned with measured motion at each update, integrated into a local trajectory, and advanced by consuming the current action. The corrected remainder is written back to the buffer, preserving motion corrections across successive updates. A bounded refresh rule normalizes speed and curvature variations within a newly decoded plan and assigns a short or long reuse budget according to the resulting plan-roughness score. translated_title: FastRoverVLA：面向越野自动驾驶的快速视觉-语言-动作执行
translated_abstract: 越野视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型会生成基于场景条件的规划，但频繁的轨迹更新会反复调用昂贵的多模态推理。重用一次预测可以减少这种计算需求，但其输出的指令却容易受到车辆运动变化的影响。FastRoverVLA通过将视觉规划生成与基于运动条件的执行解耦来解决这一不匹配问题。其无需训练的接口在两次视觉预测之间保持已解码的规划。速度-曲率动作缓冲区在每次更新时与测量到的车辆运动对齐，集成到局部轨迹中，并通过消耗当前动作向前推进。修正后的剩余动作被写回缓冲区，从而在连续的更新之间保留运动修正。有界刷新规则对新解码规划内的速度和曲率变化进行归一化，并根据所得到的规划粗糙度评分分配短或长的重用预算。该接口既不需要……
tldr: FastRoverVLA提出了一种无需训练的执行接口，通过将视觉规划生成与运动条件执行解耦，利用速度-曲率动作缓冲区持续进行运动校正，并根据规划粗糙度评分自适应分配重用预算，从而大幅减少越野自动驾驶中昂贵的多模态推理调用。
en_tdlr: FastRoverVLA introduces a training-free execution interface that decouples visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution, using a speed-curvature action buffer for continuous motion corrections and an adaptive reuse budget based on plan-roughness scoring, significantly reducing expensive multimodal inference calls in off-road autonomous driving.
